revocation_reason: The v1 consolidator can rederive equality among values supplied inside one summary receipt but does not reopen the phase-11, runtime, roundtrip, and dependency artifacts that those values purport to summarize. Its verifier now always emits qualified=false.
activation_dependencies: Arm B terminal evidence preserved and read-only audit complete.
Retained Arm B memory-phase attribution complete or terminally classified insufficient.
q1 exact source closure and program lock independently verified.
Independent q1 build A/B produces byte-identical binaries.
One clean correction-only result root and one clean scratch root per full roundtrip.
qualification_order: Prove exact integer-probability, full trace, payload, and inverse identity from reset state on the frozen opening, middle, and tail 250KB scopes.
Prove file-backed mapping lifecycle, deterministic initialization, page-out safety, and cleanup.
Prove cumulative opening-1MB identity and resource feasibility, then opening-prefix and distant cold-reset 10MB transfer before any full-corpus launch.
Independently rehash and rederive every scope, cumulative, and transfer identity receipt before it can authorize a successor phase.
Run full canonical roundtrip A alone under diagnostic process-tree and cgroup-v2 guards; do not claim current-host runtime eligibility without measured Geekbench 5 evidence.
Require exact canonical inverse and complete resource/package receipt.
Run full canonical roundtrip B alone from a clean scratch root and independent clean build.
Require A/B binary, payload, archive, and inverse identity.
Validate an online probability digest against the retained opening and distant 10M exact-trace digests, then require full byte-zero parent/q1 probability-stream identity.
Emit one consolidated qualification receipt with independent booleans.
memory_pass_rule: Pass only when process-tree peak RSS is at most 9,765,625 KiB, cgroup memory.peak is at most 10,000,000,000 bytes, largest-process VmHWM is reported, and memory.events records zero oom and oom_kill.
identity_rule: A memory-only child must reproduce the authoritative parent's exact integer probability stream, persistent state checkpoints, and payload; clean q1 A/B executions must also reproduce their package and archive. Reset-state scope identity and full payload identity do not substitute for a byte-zero full-stream online probability digest. Any mismatch creates a new compression candidate and invalidates parent-preserving qualification.
determinism_rule: Two clean source builds and two clean full-corpus executions must produce byte-identical binaries, packages, payloads, archives, and inverses under the bound host, toolchain, command, environment, and package closure.
runtime_rule: The full A/B diagnostic guards establish memory, disk, CPU-affinity, phase, cleanup, and cgroup evidence only. Runtime eligibility remains false until this host has an exact Geekbench 5 single-core receipt and compression/decompression guards are replayed with that bound score.
package_rule: Record archive, required program/model material, and every other counted byte separately; the complete sum is authoritative.
terminal_pass_branch: Authorize this realization as the memory-safe authoritative external parent for CMIX-native oracle work. Do not award Gamma compression or score credit.
terminal_identity_failure_branch: Classify q1 as a new compression candidate with no parent-preserving authority; restart the archive ladder if evidence justifies it.
terminal_resource_failure_branch: Retain compression and inverse evidence but do not qualify the parent; authorize at most one evidence-derived memory correction successor.
terminal_inverse_failure_branch: Preserve all evidence and reject the realization. Do not reinterpret partial compression output.
claim_boundary: A pass qualifies one memory-safe, two-run deterministic external parent under the bound environment. It does not establish universal determinism, official Hutter Prize verification, Gamma authorship of CMIX, or progress toward the 105M score by itself.
